translation: With that being said, it was the next morning.

The fact is—it's summer break, yet I've come
to school. Brigade chief's orders, of course.
It's about yesterday at the café.

Haruhi's ears perked up when she heard that
dreaded phrase, "unnatural phenomena.”

She stole my phone, and after interrogating
Taniguchi…

"Tomorrow morning, we'll meet at school! Bring
whatever you need for staying the night!”

Since she ordered us to, I woke up early and
began the stupidly long climb up to school.

Though, I'm again bringing an unwanted extra
with me.
Hey, sorry I'm la—
Kyon! You're late!

If you're late, it's the death penalty—I
must've told you that already!

Making your brigade chief wait under the
burning sun is a serious sin!

The death penalty for being just five minutes
late…

Don't you know our ancestors' great proverb,
"hate the sin, not the sinner”?

Incidentally, the rest of the group is already
assembled. Some things never change.

They're all able to keep up with her orders
with room to spare—they're truly incredible.

Though, while it may be morning, I do feel bad
making her wait in this harsh sunlight.

Of course, that's directed at Asahina. While
I'm at it—I'm sorry to you as well, Nagato.
Okay Kyon, prepare yourself!

First, we'll drag you around the school
grounds, then we'll chop your head off!
Koizumi, I'll let you do the execution.
It would be an honor.
…You call that an honor?
Ehehe, morning!
My, if it isn't your little sister!

The unwanted extra stuck its head out from
behind me and gave a carefree introduction.

As soon as she heard about this, she threw a
tantrum and insisted she come along.

I tried everything I could think of, but I
couldn't convince her to stay behind.

Clinging to my leg is one thing, but she really
didn't have to bite me…

And well, with the bear trap strongly clamped
around my leg…
I rushed to meet the group at school.

Besides, if my little sister's here, it seems
unlikely Haruhi would do anything too absurd.
I'm not going to deny I was also thinking that.
Hello.
Ah, Mikuru's here!

My little sister clung to Asahina's dazzling
legs.

Lucky you're my sister. Were you my brother,
you wouldn't wake up until summer ends.
Good morning.
Oh, Nagato. Good morning.
It's unusual to be greeted by Nagato.

I wonder if there's something she wants to tell
me?

We hardly talked at the café yesterday,
after all.

How has your summer break been, Nagato?
Have you gone anywhere?
Reading. I had no plans for outings.
I-is that so… Sounds good.
Good grief… Everyone's as usual, it seems.
By the way, Kyon.
What is it now?

You can't use your little sister to trick me,
you know.
There's no excuse for your tardiness.
Tsk. I was hoping otherwise.
Now now, Miss Suzumiya.

It's true that punishments and rewards are
important tools for running an organization.

However, you can't effectively run things
using punishment alone.

So in this case, perhaps we should impose a
reasonable amount of labor, wouldn't you say?
Nice, Koizumi! I'll use that idea!
Hey now…

Well Kyon, you can take all of our luggage to
the clubroom, then!
Get to it!

You're telling me to take all of this? Mine,
Haruhi's, Asahina's, Nagato's…

Koizumi's, and my sister's… that's six people's
luggage. You're telling me to take all of that?
I'll take my own.
I-I'll also take my own.

Hey, you guys don't need to hold back… Well,
whatever.
You can just carry mine and your sister's.
Hold it tight, Kyon!
…Good grief.

Why is this so heavy… What could possibly be
in Haruhi's bag?
Hey! Don't even think of peeking inside!
As if I'd want to look in there.

What am I supposed to do if I open it and get
dragged inside by a tentacle monster?
I wonder…

Okay everyone! Go put away your luggage,
then we'll head straight out!

When you say we'll head straight out, what did
you call us out here to do in the first place?

I mean, we had to bring stuff for staying
over for something, right?

What sort of trouble is Haruhi planning this
time?

It certainly seems we're staying over
somewhere.

I want to do my best to stop this from turning
into trouble.

Though knowing Haruhi, it wouldn't surprise me
if things go south quickly.
At least let me mentally prepare first.

This isn't the first time we've had a sleepover
with no warning on the first day of summer.

Summer break, sleepover, unnatural
phenomena! What do these words lead you to?
Okay, Mikuru. Answer.
Um… A test of courage, maybe?

B-but I'm not so good with that kind of thing,
so…

Nope, though I'll give you 20 points for effort.
Yuki, you're next.
Ghost stories.

That's pretty good, but still not quite right. I'll
give you 35 points. Koizumi, you're up next.
I wonder if it could be a mystery tour?

Close, so 70 points. Now, Kyon. We've come this
far, so you'd better get it right.

Even listening to the scoring she's giving out,
I don't have a clue.

Incidentally, it seems the preparations she
told us to bring were just for one night.
On top of that, she told us to bring swimwear.
Taking that into consideration…
Are we going to have a swimming contest?
No, of course not.
So why did you say swimwear was essential?

Just in case! We don't know where unnatural
phenomena might occur, after all.

Like, the ghost of a student who drowned in a
pool, regretting their short-lived life.

We can't rule out the possibility a ghost like
that might appear, can we?
Don't appear. I beg of you.
And with that, Kyon gets five points.
Are we going to be camping?

If we were going to camp, why would we gather
at school?
Good point.
Kyon, zero points.

Surely you're not planning on doing another
summer camp, right?

Oh my. Surprisingly for Kyon, a precisely
correct answer. That's 95 points.

Why am I still missing five points despite
getting the correct answer? I need to know.

You'd figure it out eventually anyways just
considering the purpose of the SOS Brigade.

First of all, explain to me what this so-called
purpose is.

What, you forgot already? Well, since it's a
good opportunity, I'll explain it clearly.

The purpose of the SOS Brigade is to search
out the mysteries of our society.

Then, we get to have fun with the aliens, time
travelers, sliders, and espers that we find!

Then you've already accomplished that. Good
for you, right?

I'm trying to figure out if I'm sad that I can't
say that, but it's reality.

Koizumi, who worships Haruhi like a god, as
does the group of espers he is a part of.

Part of a group that calls themselves the
"Agency.”

According to them, Haruhi has the ability to
magically realize anything she desires.

For better or worse, she herself is unaware
of this and can't consciously control it.

They also say that if she becomes aware of
her ability, the world will end.

Of course, I initially didn't believe such a
dubious idea.

However, in spring and summer, I saw more
than enough evidence.

It wasn't just Koizumi saying such odd
things—the other two did, as well.

Nagato, the humanoid interface for contact
with organic lifeforms.

Asahina, who came from the future to
observe Haruhi.

They each revealed their true nature and
circumstances to me.

Not to mention, I was forced into experiences
that left me no choice but to believe them.

And after all that, there was the insane
event that Haruhi caused.

Though, I somehow managed to clear it, like a
beginner adventurer from an RPG.

Thanks to that, I've developed a resistance
to unnatural occurrences.
I don't get surprised at all anymore.

With that, we'll investigate the unnatural
occurrences at the school until morning!
Ehhh!
Yay! A sleepover!
Wait a second! Haruhi!
I take back what I said before!
I see. So that's how it is.

What is how it is? Don't just accept what she
says like that.

That's how it is. Well then, let's head out at
once!
Good grief. So, where to?
The Computer Research Society obviously.

We're going to interview them about all the
unnatural phenomena they've witnessed.
I-interviews…?

Those guys seem to be staying over in their
clubroom for the time being.
Isn't that right, Koizumi?
Quite. I've heard so too.

When it comes to summer camps, we did one
first, so we win.

They're starting now, we're already on our
second. They've been completely outpaced.

This is the first I've heard that "the earlier,
the better” applies to summer camps.

So the Computer Research Society is sleeping
over, huh.

Makes you wonder what they'll be doing all
night. Just looking at things on the internet?

I don't really have an interest in how people
spend their summer vacation.
I say that, but what about the SOS Brigade?

How can I justify this pain of a brigade that
doesn't even explain its activities properly?
That's what Suzumiya just explained, right?

Good point. I probably should've recorded it
for when other people ask.

Well, whatever. For the time being I'll tell you in
more detail as we go.
If you've got that, let's go!

Good grief… Hm? Koizumi, you've also got
"good grief” written on your face.
That's not the case. Just…

This time, it seems your poor choice of words
is the cause.

It's my fault? If you have a complaint, tell it
to Taniguchi. He made the call.

The computer society guys are also at fault
for having seen these unnatural phenomena.
Sorry for butting in!
Huh! Wh-what?! What are you guys here for?!
My, quite the greeting.

I-I didn't hear that your brigade was doing
activities during summer break!

I'm not obliged to tell you. Besides, the SOS
Brigade's activities are always impromptu.
I'd say they're on a whim, but hey.

More importantly, today we came to question
you guys.
Q-question?

Wasn't it supposed to be a witness
investigation?

I'll warn you that you can't try to hide
anything! Confess clearly and honestly!

Confess?! What the hell do you think you
know?!
I have my sources, and they know everything.
That's enough. Calm down, Haruhi.
Uh, what?!
I'm sorry about that, president.
You guys are as over the top as always.

I can't help but share the sentiment in that
regard.

We heard yesterday that you all witnessed
some unnatural phenomena.
Wh-where the hell did you hear such a…
It doesn't matter where.
For now, just tell us everything you know!
Uh… right, I get it.

Either way, I'm sure you won't leave until we
do.
You understand her well.

Ugh… It was… Who was it who saw something
strange?
M-me.

Tell them everything. Then, we beg you to
leave immediately.

That's right. That seems to be the wisest
method for us all mutually.
Well, get on with it and talk!
Every little thing you remember.

Thus, Haruhi's witness investigation, or
rather interrogation, began.
It's time for inquiry mode.

You can move Kyon by tapping where you
want to go with the stylus.

You can listen to what the club members have
to say by tapping them.
Well done, Miss Suzumiya.
Phew…

That took a surprisingly long time, right?
Mikuru, can you brew some tea?
Yes, I'll do it right away!

After almost an hour of questioning, we
returned to the literary club room.

As for the so-called unnatural phenomena, in
total there were four things.
According to them—
They saw the impossible "Class 1-10.”

They heard the sound of a piano from an
empty music room.
In the night, the pool was shining eerily.

And you shouldn't peer into the mirror in the
entryway at 2:22:22 AM.

If you do, a perfect duplicate of yourself will
appear—

Each and every one of them was dubious,
but…
I really don't like it.
What don't you like?

I've investigated the seven wonders of the
school before.

Now that you mention it, I feel like you've
mentioned something like that.

What the members of the Computer Research
Society said doesn't fit at all.
It doesn't fit? As in, with the seven wonders?
Exactly. I wonder what's going on.

Perhaps they've updated the stories to keep
with the times.

They're popular these days, remakes and
such.

In general, it's way too clichéd. It's not scary
or anything at all.
And there are only four.

If you were going to make up a new seven
wonders, there are three missing.

Unbelievable, that's just like those computer
guys to make something half-assed.
What a horrible way of speaking.
Excuse me, I've brewed some tea.
Thank you, Mikuru…
The pleasure is mine.

After responding, Haruhi fell deep into
thought about something or another.

Asahina placed a cup on Haruhi's desk, and
then came to deliver tea to the rest of us.
Kyon, here you are.
Thank you very much, Asahina.

I took the cup from Asahina, which was so hot
it seemed likely to burn me.
And Koizumi, here you go.
Thank you very much.

If I were to be selfish, I would've preferred a
cool barley tea, but whatever…

There's no way I can complain about tea
Asahina made herself.
Hmmm, my tongue is burning.
And Nagato, um, your tea…

Nagato took her hot teacup with both hands
as usual, and casually took a single sip.
…Isn't that hot, Nagato?
It's fine.
That's it!
Whoa?! Wh-what?

As soon as I'd realized she'd stood up, Haruhi
started searching around for something.

Thanks to that, I almost burned my lips on my
tea.
Found it! Here it is!

Haruhi pulled out a dust-covered bundle of
papers.

What the hell is that? Dubious documents that
were stowed away in some university?

Of course not. It's an old collection of writing
from the literary club.
What's that got to do with anything?
I'm sure it's somewhere in here…

Ignoring my question, Haruhi singlemindedly
flicked through the pages.
Found it. Here it is!
What is it?
Look, right here.
Hm… "The Man-Eating Classroom”?

Right. The story of a classroom that once
you enter, you can never leave.

This surely must be about the class 1-10 that
the Computer Research Society saw!

On what basis can you make that claim?
Please tell me.

Now that we've all agreed on that, let's get
straight to the investigation!
We will now explain the Haruhi Meter.

The meter at the top of the screen is called
the "Haruhi Meter.”

The Haruhi Meter displays how much Haruhi's
focus is being…
…diverted away from unnatural phenomena.

The closer the meter is to the left, the more
Haruhi is focusing on solving the mystery.

In this case, when you start the Puzzle
Phase later…

…the speed at which Haruhi Suzumiya
approaches alternate spaces increases.

On top of that, a penalty will be added to
your time limit, and the difficulty will increase.

As the meter goes right, Haruhi's attention is
diverted toward miscellaneous information.

You will receive a bonus to your puzzle-
solving time, and the difficulty will decrease.

Depending on future choices such as "Who do
I do the action with” or "What do I choose”…

…the way Kyon chooses to act will have an
effect on the Haruhi Meter.

Try to lead Haruhi to think about things
other than unnatural phenomena.

By doing so, you can cause the meter to move
to the right side.

The current "Haruhi Meter value” is shown on
the upper screen on the left hand side.

If the meter starts heading to the left, do
what you can to return it to the right.

The basic technique for moving the Haruhi
Meter to the right, is as follows:

1: Try to make Haruhi the topic of
conversation as much as you can.

2: When grouping, try not to leave Haruhi on
her own, and preferably have Kyon join her.

This concludes the explanation of the Haruhi
Meter.
Once again ignoring my question, huh?

Wait, Haruhi, Asahina made tea especially for
you!
Tea?

Haruhi stared at me, and grasped the teacup
before her eyes…

She drank it dry in one go. Not that I care,
but are you also immune to hot liquids?
Now we're sorted. Alright, let's go!

Nothing I can do. Maybe I'll drink it when I get
back, but it'll probably be cold by then.
Have we sufficiently investigated everyone?

Then go ask them! If you keep complaining
the sun will go down!
Good grief…

Seems she won't be satisfied unless we've
heard everyone's story…

Then, let's return to the clubroom and have a
strategy meeting. We'll be very busy!

A strategy meeting? What the hell are we
going to talk about there…
What is it? Do you have some business?
It's not that…

Somehow he seemed to have a bit of an
attitude. Well, I suppose that's natural.

We did steal their computer the first time we
met, after all.

I'm sure you're busy, but could I ask you
about the unnatural phenomena?

Even if I didn't want to, you guys aren't going
to leave, right?
"You guys” meaning Haruhi, of course.

Ask the others. I don't know any of the
details.

Hm? In other words, the president didn't
witness the unnatural phenomena himself?

Even though he was staying in this room with
the others…

Well, might as well try asking the other club
members for the time being.
Do you still need something?

Even if you didn't witness anything, did you
notice anything strange at all?
I would've already told you if I had.

We'd all like you to leave as soon as possible
please.

Hiding something…? He doesn't really appear
to be.

Is it true that you experienced some
unnatural phenomena?
Y-yes… There's no mistaking it.
Exactly what kind of thing?
It was right about this time of day.

As I was walking down the hall, I felt a
strange uneasiness…
Uneasiness?

Yeah, somehow the hallway felt longer than
usual.
It wasn't just… in your head?

In the beginning I thought so too, but… then I
saw it.
Saw? What…?
"Class 1-10”!

Class 10… but there shouldn't be more than 9
classes in year 1…

Of course I know that! But it was really
there!

Nobody believes me when I tell them! I'm going
crazy!

Setting the statement's veracity aside, it's
obviously seriously affected this guy.
It seems best to leave it here.
Dammit! Why does no one believe me!
I'll talk to him again when he's calmed down.
Excuse me…
…Wh-what do you need from me?

Uh… I don't know why, but at a glance he
looks like he's at his limit.

Is it because of being up all night for a few
nights, or the fault of unnatural phenomena?
Do you mind if I ask you some questions?

I was told you encountered an unnatural
phenomenon.

I-indeed, I could hear it! A melody from the
empty music room!

You could hear it… someone was playing the
piano?
I went to check right away!
But, no one was in the music room…
So you're saying the piano was playing itself?
Absolutely it was… Yes, there's no mistaking it.

You could hear the sound of a piano from an
empty music room… Right?
Well, anything else…?

Y-yes. I have to record it… If I don't do it
quickly, it won't finish…

There's no hope… He's no longer got a grasp
on reality.

It doesn't seem like he'll tell me any more than
that.
Um, excuse me…

I need to sample it and compress it… Yes, and
sound effects…
He's not listening…
Could I ask you a few questions?
What is it? I'm busy right now, you know.

Just for a bit. I heard you guys encountered
some unnatural phenomena…
Oh that…

Simply put, in the middle of the night, I saw a
bright light coming from the pool.
The pool was… shining?
Yeah, I was just there absentmindedly.

I didn't get a closer look so I can't say
concretely what it was, though.

It wasn't a normal light. I can say that for
sure.

I don't know on what basis he determined it
was "not normal,” though…

You seem to be quite calm. Very different from
the other club members.

There's nothing I can do about it. Besides, I
have a lot of work to do at the moment.

Don't mean to be rude, but once you're
finished with me I want to get back to my work.
Ah, yes. My bad.
Anything else?
Ah, no…
I can't get in the way of his work too much…

Excuse me, but could I ask you some
questions—
About unnatural phenomena?!
Uh… Y-yes…
I'm glad you asked!

The truth is, I always thought that mirror was
suspicious!
Mirror? What are you talking about…?

What do you mean "what”? The 2 AM mirror, of
course! Uh? What? Don't you know about it?
Ah…

If you look at this one mirror that's
somewhere in the school at 2:22:22 AM…

A duplicate of yourself comes out of the mir-
ror and changes places with you! That story!
Huh…

This isn't so much an encounter with un-
natural phenomena as it is an urban legend.

So, I've been investigating the location of
that mirror for a while…

But just the other day, I found out it was the
mirror in the school entryway.

The entryway? How the hell did you find that
out?

Huh? What was it again? I heard it from
someone, but…

I completely forgot. But, I heard it from a
very reliable source!
R-right…
Somehow that started to sound very dubious.

What's that? There's more you want to ask
about? That's fine, ask away!

Once you start asking he doesn't seem to
want to stop…

That's fine, it's nothing. You can get back to
your work without worrying about it.

Really? If there's anything you want to hear
about, please ask away!
A-ah, understood. Thank you.

Well, I've heard everyone's story, but… I'll just
say it as it is. I want to go home right away.

When it comes to reporting this to Haruhi, just
thinking about it gives me a headache.

On the other hand, she's over there probably
about to burst with anticipation, so…
I guess I'll go tell her what I've learned.
Go swimming
Go camping
Summer camp
No, not yet.
Of course.
